what: Record of a second, separately made transcription of the Week 11 injury report read on 2026-11-19. Hashes and counts only: no player names are published here.
method: The seven fetch_page chunks (chunkIndex 0 to 6) were transcribed a second time by session de30e06c, then compared row for row against the primary file (same header, same 253 rows, identical sets). The sorted-row SHA-256 is computed over the data lines, sorted, joined by newlines, UTF-8.
limit: Both transcriptions come from the same fetch_page text. This shows the transcription is consistent, not that it equals nfl.com's bytes. The second transcription file is not kept, so this hash cannot be re-derived from the repository alone.
unresolved: The brief's 254-row figure is not reconciled (F-34). One possible explanation is that the TSV has 254 lines including its header; this is a hypothesis, not verified.
